notes.zh-CN: 手机现在可以浏览电脑上的项目会话并接力续聊：新增自建同步服务（与飞书授权服务同一容器），电脑上传会话摘要与正文，手机只读正文、只下发指令，飞书仍只负责账号验证与快捷指令。本次同时修复了授权服务在 Workers 上的两处运行时缺陷与飞书 20049（PKCE）错误。macOS 为通用包；Windows 为未签名安装包；APK 为调试签名，IPA 为开发签名，只能安装到开发团队已注册的设备。
notes.en: The phone can now browse desktop project sessions and continue them: a self-hosted sync service (same container as the Feishu auth service) receives transcripts from the computer, while the phone only reads transcripts and queues commands; Feishu stays limited to account verification and quick commands. This release also fixes two runtime defects in the hosted auth service and the Feishu 20049 (PKCE) error. macOS ships universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed, so it only installs on devices registered with the development team.
